items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions Carroll O'Connor only in the context of his daughter's school acquaintances: 'She knows the Hilton family chain, and the guy that used to be on – Carroll O’Connor – what was . . .? Carroll O’Connor’s son used to help her out with her science... She knows these people.'

ctx.x: Did you finish? Did you earn your degree there?

No, I left after 2½ years. I wasn’t really getting what I wanted. The English was great. Let me tell you about that English. This guy, Mr. Carroll, I’ll tell you. It was a nightmare, because instead of – most teachers would say, do page so-and-so. This guy would say, “Do chapter 16 and chapter 17 and chapter 18 and chapter 19 for tomorrow.” I’d finish the other homework in a couple of hours, stay up all night doing his homework. But I learned so much from him. So when they sent me – when that quarter was over,…
